question: Which of the following is NOT an integral component of the MS-Office 365 suite?
solution:
The correct answer is__** MS-Paint.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​MS-Paint is not a component of MS Office 365. 
 
• The main components of MS Office are given below:
 
 
• **Microsoft Teams, **
 
• **Word, Excel. **
 
• **Powerpoint. **
 
• **Outlook.**
 
• **One note.**
 
• **One drive.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Microsoft word is a word processor software developed by Microsoft in 1983. 
 
• **OneDrive is the Microsoft cloud service that connects you to all your files. It lets you stock and save your files, share them with others, and get to them from any place on all your devices. **
 
• 
 
 
**Microsoft Access** is a database management system (DBMS) used **to store and manage data**.
